rule: A clip is listed when its footage shows (1) genital, perineal, vulval, vaginal or cervical exposure, including procedures through a speculum and realistic genital or birth simulation models; (2) vaginal birth or a birth complication; or (3) open surgery on a visible patient body (skin incision, opened abdomen, uterus, skull or neck). Not listed: laparoscopic, endoscopic, hysteroscopic, robotic or microscope views inside the body, ultrasound and other imaging, animations and illustrations, bench models that are not anatomical (bread, foam, tissue pads), and examinations of non-intimate body parts.
method: Candidates from VideoClip and VideoSource titles and clip labels (all 519 clips in the configured database, 29 Oct 2026); every candidate poster frame (240), plus 50 borderline non-candidates, was looked at before listing.
